title: One Platform. Four Analyst Recognitions across Modern Infrastructure and AI.
summary: Learn why Nutanix was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure — unifying hybrid, edge, and AI under one platform.
body_markdown:
Organizations today need a consistent way to manage applications, data, and AI across increasingly distributed environments. At Nutanix, our vision is to deliver a unified platform spanning infrastructure, virtualization, containers, storage, and AI. We believe recent Gartner recognition reflects the progress we've made toward that goal, including recognition in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ evaluations for[Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure](https://www.nutanix.com/go/2026-gartner-mq-for-distributed-hybrid-infrastructure) ,[Server Virtualization Platforms](https://www.nutanix.com/go/gartner-mq-2026-server-virtualization-platforms) , and[Container Management](https://www.nutanix.com/go/gartner-mq-2026-container-management) .


Separately, Nutanix was recognized as a Leader in the[Forrester Wave™ for Object Storage Solutions](https://www.nutanix.com/blog/decoding-our-take-on-nutanixs-position-as-a-leader-in-the-forrester-wave) and named a Customer Favorite.


"Our customers are navigating unprecedented complexity as they scale applications and data across hybrid cloud, edge, and AI environments. They need an operating model that tames that complexity. That unified experience is exactly what we deliver. We view this recognition as a testament to our rapid pace of innovation, continuing to evolve our architecture to help organizations adapt to changing requirements and support their efforts as they transform their businesses for an AI-enabled world, including secure, sovereign Agentic AI deployments across hybrid cloud and edge environments."
*Thomas Cornely, EVP Product Management at Nutanix*


## A Unified Platform for Infrastructure, Data, and AI


Together, these recognitions span the foundational technologies required for modern hybrid cloud and AI environments, including distributed infrastructure, virtualization, Kubernetes® management, and object storage. We believe they reflect the breadth of the Nutanix portfolio and the value of a unified platform approach. The[Nutanix Cloud Platform](https://www.nutanix.com/products/cloud-platform) , combined with[Nutanix Enterprise AI](https://www.nutanix.com/products/nutanix-enterprise-ai) , helps organizations manage applications, data, and AI through a consistent operating model across distributed environments.


## A Unified Operating Model for a Distributed World


As organizations support a mix of traditional applications, cloud-native services, and AI workloads, operational complexity continues to grow. Nutanix capabilities help customers to manage VMs, containers, and AI applications through a common operating model, helping simplify operations and governance across datacenter, cloud, and edge environments.


## Addressing New Hybrid Cloud and AI Requirements


As organizations move AI initiatives into production, infrastructure flexibility, security, and governance become increasingly important.


Over the past year, Nutanix has expanded hybrid cloud capabilities through broader support for[Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2)](https://www.nutanix.com/products/nutanix-cloud-clusters) across public, government, and sovereign clouds, while adding innovations such as Multicloud Snapshot Technology, expanded cloud storage integrations, and cloud-native file services.


Nutanix has also introduced new AI capabilities, including Nutanix Enterprise AI, Agent Gateway for LLM governance, integrated model security, and[NKP Metal](https://www.nutanix.com/press-releases/2026/nutanix-introduces-nkp-metal-bringing-bare-metal-kubernetes-to-its-platform) for bare-metal Kubernetes deployments (in development). Additional security enhancements help organizations strengthen protection, improve governance, and maintain consistent controls across VM, Kubernetes, and AI environments.


Together, these capabilities help organizations:


- Run any workload anywhere
- Address compliance and sovereignty requirements
- Operate consistently across cloud, datacenter, and edge environments
- Accelerate AI adoption
- Maintain security and governance at scale


## Architectural Flexibility with External Storage


Most organizations need to modernize while preserving existing investments.


Nutanix's support for[external storage integrations](https://www.nutanix.com/products/nutanix-cloud-infrastructure/compute) with[Dell PowerFlex and Dell PowerStore](https://www.nutanix.com/dell) ,[Everpure Storage](https://www.nutanix.com/everpure) , and[NetApp](https://www.nutanix.com/netapp) (in development) gives customers the flexibility to adopt modern operating models without requiring wholesale storage replacement. This approach can help organizations modernize at their own pace while helping manage complexity while preserving selected existing investments.


## Looking Ahead


More than a decade ago, Nutanix helped simplify infrastructure through hyperconverged infrastructure. Today, organizations need a unified platform for applications, data, Kubernetes, and AI across distributed environments.


We believe our recognition across Gartner Magic Quadrant™ evaluations for[Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure](https://www.nutanix.com/go/2026-gartner-mq-for-distributed-hybrid-infrastructure) ,[Server Virtualization Platforms](https://www.nutanix.com/go/gartner-mq-2026-server-virtualization-platforms) , and[Container Management](https://www.nutanix.com/go/gartner-mq-2026-container-management) reflects the progress we've made toward that vision.


To us, being recognized as a Leader in the[Forrester Wave™ for Object Storage Solutions](https://www.nutanix.com/blog/decoding-our-take-on-nutanixs-position-as-a-leader-in-the-forrester-wave) further demonstrates the strength of our data platform.


Together, the Nutanix Cloud Platform help organizations simplify operations, accelerate innovation, and maintain control wherever applications, data, and AI reside.


---


Gartner, Inc, Magic Quadrant for Distributed Hybrid Infrastructure, Julia Palmer, Daniel Bowers, Adrian Wong, Elaine Zhang, 7 September 2026
